mapper.select: SELECT id, token, user_id, username, create_time, expire_time, last_access_time FROM APIGRAB_USER_TOKEN WHERE token = #{token}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APIGRAB_USER_TOKEN (token, user_id, username, expire_time, last_access_time) VALUES (#{token}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{expireTime}, #{lastAccessTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE APIGRAB_USER_TOKEN SET last_access_time = #{lastAccessTime}, expire_time = #{expireTime} WHERE token = #{token}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM APIGRAB_USER_TOKEN WHERE expire_time < NOW()
